verdict.rationale: Letta documents a dedicated headless mode for running Letta Code non-interactively, explicitly for scripts, CI/CD pipelines and composing with UNIX tools. It also offers an --ephemeral flag for one-shot tasks that skip agent persistence, which suits CI runs. Missing for 10: details on CI authentication and output formats, and any independent or hands-on corroboration of headless/CI use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Headless mode allows you to run Letta Code non-interactively, making it easy to integrate into scripts, CI/CD pipelines, or compose with other UNIX tools.
Use --ephemeral to run a one-shot task without creating, resuming, or persisting an agent, memory blocks, or MemFS
